title: HB 3195 (107th General Assembly): As enacted, allows state employee upon retirement to keep such employee's photo identification card issued by the state; requires sticker or other designation to be placed on the card; specifies such card may be used as valid photo id for voting purposes. - Amends TCA Section 2-7-112 and Title 8.
operative_text:
(a_in_person_id)
(section) Sec. 2, TCA 2-7-112(c) new subdivision
(quote) (_) An employee identification card for retired state employees authorized pursuant to § 8-50-118;
(b_no_id_remedy) not stated.
(c_mail_ballot_id) not stated.
(d_proof_of_citizenship) not stated.
(e_other_rule) not stated.
(other) Sec. 1: new TCA 8-50-118, a retiring state employee keeps the state photo ID card, with a sticker or other mark showing retired status.
(other) Sec. 3: takes effect on becoming law.
(other) version: Draft 552622 (filed 2012-01-25): only saved version. Carries slot a text (adds the retired state employee ID card to the 2-7-112(c) accepted-ID list); slots b-e not stated.
(other) note: The House bill itself did not pass a floor vote in the saved votes; the companion Senate bill was substituted and became Pub. Ch. 938. The enacted wording is not saved here, so only the filed text is quoted. No floor roll call is saved. The 2-7-112(c) list it adds to is not reprinted.
